name: Call-Side 1-1-2 (Reverse 112)
summary: The 112 built on calls: a long call debit spread financed by two further-OTM naked short calls, harvesting rich call skew in commodities and squeeze-prone names.

legs.strike_rule: call delta 0.25-0.30, completing the debit spread
call delta 0.05-0.10, >= 10% above spot - the two NAKED calls

max_profit: net credit + debit-spread width x 100 at the spread's upper strike with both naked calls worthless
max_loss: UNDEFINED and unlimited above the naked strike - 2 x $100 per point with no upper bound
breakevens: upper BE approximately = naked strike + [net credit + debit-spread max value] / 2 per share

greeks.delta: negative above the debit spread, roughly -0.10 to -0.25 per unit

when_to_use: INCLUDED FOR COMPLETENESS ONLY - NOT TRADEABLE AT LEVEL 3. Used in energy and softs where call skew is rich; on equity ETFs the call skew is usually too flat to pay for the tail.
entry_rules: BLOCKED: two uncovered short calls, theoretically unlimited loss; requires Alpaca options level 4.
LEVEL 3 SUBSTITUTE: convert both naked calls into call credit spreads (6 legs, outside the scope cap) or cover them with 200 shares, which turns the structure into a ratio-covered write.
If ever enabled: IV rank >= 40, call skew positive, hard buy-stop in the underlying at the upper breakeven, no entry on any name with short interest > 10% of float.
management_rules: Take profit at 50% of max structure value.
Close the naked calls if their delta reaches 0.20.
Unconditional close on any halt-for-volatility or takeover headline in the underlying.
exit_rules: ASSIGNMENT GUARD: all short calls flat by 15:30 ET on expiration day.
Close any short call at extrinsic < $0.10 or delta >= 0.85, and before every ex-dividend date while ITM.
Naked call assignment creates 200 short shares with no long stock behind them - an unbounded liability on an account that must never be assigned.
assignment_risk: Catastrophic. Three short calls, two uncovered; assignment is a 200-share naked short at the strike and can be exercised early for the dividend.
buying_power: Uncovered call margin on 2 contracts (roughly 20% of underlying value plus premium) recomputed daily.
liquidity_needs: Irrelevant here - not tradeable at level 3.
common_mistakes: Assuming upside gaps are smaller than downside gaps; they are not in single names.
family: Completeness gap-fill (cross-family): ratio/naked-financed put and call structures, quantity-unbalanced condors and strangles, stock+option overlays and monetizations, capital-protection and hybrid builds, 0DTE four-leg income, volatility-surface and relative-value trades, event-driven overlays, and roll/adjustment structures
blocked_because: needs Alpaca options level 4; this account is level 3. Alpaca rejects it with 'account not eligible to trade uncovered option contracts'. Raising the level is an Alpaca approval, not a code change.
